pairs.target: dìèrtiān sònglái de gōnghán lǐ , yǒu yìzhāng bái jiē xuégōng de huíxiào tōngzhī .
pairs.english: The official mail delivered the next day included a notice to return to the White Steps academy.
pairs.hanzi: 第二天送来的公函里，有一张白阶学宫的回校通知。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiān kànjiàn huíxiào de rì hào , zài tóng ruǎn héng bǎ lùshang de rìzi āigè shù le yíbiàn : jùjīn bātiān , shàngwǔ dàochǎng , jiāo zhè duàn shí zuò de jìlù , yǔ dài jiào de rén yìqǐ tán .
pairs.english: Tavi first found the return date, then counted the travel days one by one with Ruan Heng: eight days from now, attend in the morning, submit the placement records, and talk together with his supervisor.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维先看见回校的日号，再同阮衡把路上的日子挨个数了一遍：距今八天，上午到场，交这段实作的记录，与带教的人一起谈。

pairs.target: zhào tāmen láishí zǒu de gōnglù , dìliùtiān dòngshēn , dìqītiān néng jìnchéng , yèlǐ réng zhù xuégōng .
pairs.english: Following the road they had come by, they would leave on the sixth day, reach the city on the seventh, and sleep at the academy as before.
pairs.hanzi: 照他们来时走的公路，第六天动身，第七天能进城，夜里仍住学宫。

pairs.target: " búshì kǎo nǐ néng jìzhù duōshǎo xiāngzǐ . " ruǎn héng shuō zhe , jiāng zìjǐ de jìlù yě fàngjìn zhǐjiá , " búguò nà zhāng quán xiě cuòliè de bié rēng , wǒ yào dài . "
pairs.english: “They aren't testing how many crates you can remember.” Ruan Heng put his own records in the folder as he spoke. “But don't throw away the sheet you put entirely in the wrong column. I'm taking it.”
pairs.hanzi: “不是考你能记住多少箱子。”阮衡说着，将自己的记录也放进纸夹，“不过那张全写错列的别扔，我要带。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wèn néng bunéng dài zìjǐ huà de yú . ruǎn héng méi míngbái , děng kànjiàn nà bànzhāng lán zhǐ , biàn wèn zhè suàn yìn bù háishì yǎngyú .
pairs.english: Tavi asked if he could bring his fish drawing. Ruan Heng didn't understand until he saw the half-sheet of blue paper, then asked if this counted as cloth printing or fish farming.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维问能不能带自己画的鱼。阮衡没明白，等看见那半张蓝纸，便问这算印布还是养鱼。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shōuhuí qù , yā zài gěi sè lā de bùtiáo dǐxià .
pairs.english: Tavi took it back and tucked it under the cloth strip for Sela.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维收回去，压在给瑟拉的布条底下。

pairs.target: bàngwǎn wēn xiù lái jiào rén , shuō shūfù yuànlǐ jīnwǎn yǎn bù yǐngxì , qiánjǐrì jiè qù shì yìn de bù biān zhènghǎo nálái wéi tái .
pairs.english: That evening Wenxiu came to fetch them: her uncle's courtyard was hosting a shadow play that night, with the cloth edging borrowed for trial printing a few days earlier now enclosing the stage.
pairs.hanzi: 傍晚温岫来叫人，说叔父院里今晚演布影戏，前几日借去试印的布边正好拿来围台。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiāng liáng jià de jìlù guī hǎo , chī le wǎnfàn cái xiàpō , wèi dào yuànmén , yǐ tīngjiàn liǎngpiàn mùbǎn pāi dé xiàng jí mǎ xiàshān .
pairs.english: Tavi filed his rack measurements, ate dinner, and went downhill. Before reaching the courtyard gate he heard two wooden boards clattering like a horse hurrying down a mountain.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维将量架的记录归好，吃了晚饭才下坡，未到院门，已听见两片木板拍得像急马下山。

pairs.target: yuàn zhōngyāng guà zhe yìfú báibù , bèihòu diǎn le yǒu zhào de dēng . guānzhòng zuòzài dēngguāng zhàobúdào de zhè yímiàn , kàn rén jiāng báo pí jiǎnchū de yǐng ǒu jǔ dào bù hòu ,
pairs.english: A white cloth hung in the courtyard center, a hooded lamp lit behind it. The audience sat on the unlit side, watching figures cut from thin hide being held up behind the cloth;
pairs.hanzi: 院中央挂着一幅白布，背后点了有罩的灯。观众坐在灯光照不到的这一面，看人将薄皮剪出的影偶举到布后，

pairs.target: chánggān yì zhuǎn , píngpíngde yípiàn biàn yǒu le zhuǎnshēn gōng yāo de yàngzi . fēng cóng biānshàng zuānjìnqù , bùmiàn gǔqǐlái , xì lǐ de lǎorén yě gēnzhe hū pàng hū shòu .
pairs.english: One turn of a long rod made a flat piece seem to turn and bow. Wind slipped in at the edge and billowed the cloth, making the play's old man suddenly fat, then thin.
pairs.hanzi: 长杆一转，平平的一片便有了转身躬腰的样子。风从边上钻进去，布面鼓起来，戏里的老人也跟着忽胖忽瘦。

pairs.target: xià róng tóng biǎomèi zhàn zhe dìsānpái de chángdèng . tā shuō jīntiān de jíjiàn yǐ jiāo , yìng jǐ gěi tǎ wéi bàngè rén kuān de wèizhì , biǎomèi què jiāng yìxiǎobāo chǎo dòu xiān fàngzài nàlǐ , wèn tā píng shénme bǐ dòuzǐ zuò dé hǎo .
pairs.english: Xiarong and her cousin occupied a bench in the third row. Her urgent parcel delivered for the day, she squeezed out half a person's space for Tavi, but her cousin put a small packet of roasted beans there first and asked why he deserved a better seat than the beans.
pairs.hanzi: 夏绒同表妹占着第三排的长凳。她说今天的急件已交，硬挤给塔维半个人宽的位置，表妹却将一小包炒豆先放在那里，问他凭什么比豆子坐得好。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiāng dòuzǐ jiēdào shǒulǐ , tā biàn xiào zhe wǎng pángbiān ràng .
pairs.english: Tavi took the beans, and she laughed and moved aside.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维将豆子接到手里，她便笑着往旁边让。

pairs.target: tái shàngyǎn de shì yìqún rén cóng dàshuǐ lǐ wǎng shānshàng qiān . jiǎnzhǐ shìde làng juàn guò chuándǐ , lǎorén diū le guō , háizi zhǎo búdào xié , yígè gāogāo dài zhe bái pái de rén tì dàjiā zhǎodào chuān wù de mén .
pairs.english: Onstage, people were migrating from floodwaters into the mountains. Paper-like waves rolled beneath boats, an old man lost his pot, a child couldn't find shoes, and someone with a white tally worn high found everyone a door through the mist.
pairs.hanzi: 台上演的是一群人从大水里往山上迁。剪纸似的浪卷过船底，老人丢了锅，孩子找不到鞋，一个高高戴着白牌的人替大家找到穿雾的门。

pairs.target: měi zhǎohuí yìtiáo lù , bái pái shàng biàn duō yídào héng hén . tǎ wéi wàng zhe nà yìxiǎopiàn tòuliàng de báisè , xiǎngqǐ nài lěi de páizi yě zhǐyǒu sāndào ; kě táishàng de rén yǐ zhǎodào le dìwǔ shànmén .
pairs.english: Each recovered route added a horizontal notch to the tally. Tavi watched that little translucent white patch and remembered Nerai's tally had only three; yet the figure onstage had already found a fifth door.
pairs.hanzi: 每找回一条路，白牌上便多一道横痕。塔维望着那一小片透亮的白色，想起奈蕾的牌子也只有三道；可台上的人已找到了第五扇门。

pairs.target: qiánpái yǒurén dīshēng shuō , zhèlǐ gāi yǒu zhī gǒu . lìng yígè rén shuō gǒu zài xiàbànchǎng , yǎodiào guǎn liáng rén de bàntiáo kùzǐ .
pairs.english: Someone in the front row murmured that there should be a dog here. Another said the dog came in the second half and bit off half the grain keeper's trousers.
pairs.hanzi: 前排有人低声说，这里该有只狗。另一个人说狗在下半场，咬掉管粮人的半条裤子。

pairs.target: nà rén bùfú , shuō zìjǐ xiǎoshíhòu kàn , gǒu cóngtóu biàn gēnzhe háizi , hòulái cái jiù dé le lǎorén .
pairs.english: The first disagreed: when he'd watched as a child, the dog had followed the child from the start, which was how it later saved the old man.
pairs.hanzi: 那人不服，说自己小时候看，狗从头便跟着孩子，后来才救得了老人。

pairs.target: bù hòu de lǎorén hūrán késou qǐlái , hāidé tàijiǔ , cāo ǒu de rén lùchū bànjié shǒuwàn .
pairs.english: The old man behind the cloth suddenly began coughing, for so long that the puppeteer's wrist showed halfway.
pairs.hanzi: 布后的老人忽然咳嗽起来，咳得太久，操偶的人露出半截手腕。

pairs.target: xiǎoháizi men qíshēng xiào , nà zhī zhēng le bàntiān de gǒu jiù zài zhèshí chōng chūlái , yǎozhù le lǎorén de xié . táishàngtáixià dōu luàn le , tǎ wéi gēnzhe xiào , jiāng dòuzǐ chàdiǎn dǎo jìn xià róng xiùkǒu .
pairs.english: The children laughed together. The much-disputed dog charged out then and seized the old man's shoe. Stage and audience erupted, and Tavi laughed along, nearly tipping the beans into Xiarong's cuff.
pairs.hanzi: 小孩子们齐声笑，那只争了半天的狗就在这时冲出来，咬住了老人的鞋。台上台下都乱了，塔维跟着笑，将豆子差点倒进夏绒袖口。

pairs.target: guò le yíhuìer , làng jìngxiàlái , shāndǐng de mén bì shàng .
pairs.english: After a while the waves stilled and the door on the mountaintop closed.
pairs.hanzi: 过了一会儿，浪静下来，山顶的门闭上。

pairs.target: bái pái de rén zhàn zài ménwài , xiǎng huíqù zhǎo méi gēnshàng de rén , mén lǐ què chuánlái shuí yě bùxǔ zài kāi de chàngcí .
pairs.english: The white-tally figure stood outside, wanting to go back for those left behind, but a song from within forbade anyone to open the door again.
pairs.hanzi: 白牌的人站在门外，想回去找没跟上的人，门里却传来谁也不许再开的唱词。

pairs.target: chàng de rén sǎngzi bìng bù gāo , yǒu yíjù xiàngshì méi chuǎn zú qì , duàn zài bàntú , yuànlǐ fǎnér jìng le .
pairs.english: The singer's voice wasn't loud; one line seemed to run out of breath and broke midway, leaving the courtyard quiet instead.
pairs.hanzi: 唱的人嗓子并不高，有一句像是没喘足气，断在半途，院里反而静了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiàngqián qīng le qīng . tā yǐwéi jiēxiàlái huì jiàndào ménwài nàxiē rén , báibù shàng què zhī yìngchū yìtiáo chángchángde shānyǐng .
pairs.english: Tavi leaned forward. He thought he would next see the people outside, but only a long mountain silhouette appeared on the white cloth.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维向前倾了倾。他以为接下来会见到门外那些人，白布上却只映出一条长长的山影。

pairs.target: dēng yí àn , mài rèchá de nǚrén biàn tíhú chuān jìn rénqún , bào le jià , xì zànqiě xiē xià .
pairs.english: When the lamp dimmed, a woman selling hot tea carried her kettle through the crowd and called her price. The play paused.
pairs.hanzi: 灯一暗，卖热茶的女人便提壶穿进人群，报了价，戏暂且歇下。

pairs.target: " mén guān le , zhēn jiù méi rén chūqù ? " tǎ wéi wèn . xià róng hái zài cóng xiùkǒu lǐ zhǎo nà kē dòu .
pairs.english: “Once the door closed, did nobody really go out?” Tavi asked. Xiarong was still hunting in her cuff for that bean.
pairs.hanzi:
“门关了，真就没人出去？”塔维问。
夏绒还在从袖口里找那颗豆。

pairs.target: " zhège běnzi shì zhèyàng . nánbiān yìzhàn de wǒ yě kànguò , hòutou yǒu tiáo chuán . nǐ wèn wǒ nǎgè shì zhēnde , wǒ bù zhīdào , wǒ liǎnghuí dōu zhī huā le kàn xì de qián . "
pairs.english: “That's this version. I've seen one at the southern station too, with a boat later on. If you ask which is true, I don't know. Both times I only paid to watch a play.”
pairs.hanzi: “这个本子是这样。南边驿站的我也看过，后头有条船。你问我哪个是真的，我不知道，我两回都只花了看戏的钱。”

pairs.target: biǎomèi shuō yǒu chuán de nàge méi gǒu , bù hǎokàn . liǎng rén zhēng qǐlái , tǎ wéi méiyǒu chāhuà .
pairs.english: Her cousin said the one with the boat had no dog and wasn't any good. The two argued, and Tavi didn't interrupt.
pairs.hanzi: 表妹说有船的那个没狗，不好看。两人争起来，塔维没有插话。

pairs.target: tā kànzhe báibù hòu de rén dūnxià hēshuǐ , nàge dàibái pái de yǐng ǒu bèi gē zài zhúlán yán shàng , xì tuǐ xuán zài wàitou , pángbiān yā zhe gǒu hé bàngè shàngwèi yòng shàng de tàiyáng .
pairs.english: He watched people behind the white cloth crouch to drink. The white-tally puppet rested on a bamboo basket's rim, thin legs dangling outside, beside the dog and half a sun not yet used.
pairs.hanzi: 他看着白布后的人蹲下喝水，那个戴白牌的影偶被搁在竹篮沿上，细腿悬在外头，旁边压着狗和半个尚未用上的太阳。

pairs.target: xiàyìchǎng , mén lǐ de liángshí búgòu chī le . lǎorén yào àn jiù míngzì fēn , niánqīngrén bèi lái de kǒudài què méiyǒu míngzì .
pairs.english: In the next scene, food inside the door ran short. The old man wanted to divide it by the old names, but the sacks the young people had carried bore no names.
pairs.hanzi: 下一场，门里的粮食不够吃了。老人要按旧名字分，年轻人背来的口袋却没有名字。

pairs.target: jǐgè rén zài bù hòu lúnhuàn sǎngyīn , chǎo dé xiàng shōuhuò chù yǒurén rèncuò le huò . hòupái yíwèi lǎotàitài hūrán shuō , zìjǐ āniáng chàng zhège , niánqīngrén zuìhòu shì chēngchuán zǒu de .
pairs.english: Several people alternated voices behind the cloth, arguing like someone had mistaken a consignment at the receiving office. An old woman at the back suddenly said that when her mother sang this, the young people left by boat in the end.
pairs.hanzi: 几个人在布后轮换嗓音，吵得像收货处有人认错了货。后排一位老太太忽然说，自己阿娘唱这个，年轻人最后是撑船走的。

pairs.target: pángbiān de rén qǐng tā xiǎoshēng , tā dāying le , gé le piànkè yòu hēngqǐlái . tǎ wéi méiyǒu huítóu , zhī bǎ shǒulǐ de chǎo dòu dìgěi xià róng .
pairs.english: Someone beside her asked her to be quiet. She agreed, then hummed again a moment later. Tavi didn't turn, only passing the roasted beans in his hand to Xiarong.
pairs.hanzi: 旁边的人请她小声，她答应了，隔了片刻又哼起来。塔维没有回头，只把手里的炒豆递给夏绒。

pairs.target: báibù bèi fēngchuī dé wēiwēi qǐfú , mén yǐng yìshí hé shàng , yìshí liúchū yídào zhǎi fèng ; nà shì táijià de biānjiǎo sōng le , gēn xì lǐ chàng de bìng méiyǒu guānxì . tā réng kàn le hěn jiǔ .
pairs.english: Wind rippled the white cloth gently, the door's shadow closing now and opening a narrow crack then; a corner of the stage frame had loosened, unrelated to the song. He still watched for a long time.
pairs.hanzi: 白布被风吹得微微起伏，门影一时合上，一时留出一道窄缝；那是台架的边角松了，跟戏里唱的并没有关系。他仍看了很久。
